worldcombat.skill.detect.summary: Read the next attack inside a very short window and fully evade it, earning a burst of opening (Speed by default, Attack if configured). Repeated use tends to fail.
worldcombat.skill.detect.description.0: Read window %1$s, opening %2$s (%3$s level); higher Speed widens the window and lengthens the opening.
worldcombat.skill.detect.description.2: Repeat-use failure rate %1$s; the reposition/counter trade-off is the %2$s setting.
worldcombat.skill.detect.use.0: Tear apart the first blow the moment it starts
worldcombat.skill.detect.use.1: Read while closing, then strike back
worldcombat.skill.detect.preference.stri: Off (reposition): the read raises Speed with a wider window (x1.15), using the opening to create distance. On (counter): it raises Attack, but window x0.85, recover +2 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.detect.preference.ai.r: Consider reading once a threat enters this range. Larger raises the curtain earlier but may read before the opponent acts.
